name: io.github.SaqibNaseer404/outboundauth
title: OutboundAuth Deliverability
description: Free SPF, DKIM, DMARC, blacklist, MX and bounce checks for any domain, as MCP tools for AI agents.

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Look up the live SPF TXT record for a domain and evaluate it: version tag, default policy (-all vs ~all), the 10-DNS-lookup limit, PTR use. Returns a scored verdict with findings.

tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.description: Look up the live DMARC TXT record at _dmarc.<domain> and evaluate it: policy (none/quarantine/reject), aggregate reporting (rua). Returns a scored verdict with findings.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Look up the live DKIM TXT record for a selector (<selector>._domainkey.<domain>) and evaluate the key: version, key type, public key presence. Follows CNAMEs (e.g. Microsoft 365 / Google selectors).

selector.description: DKIM selector, e.g. google, selector1, s1 (ask the email provider if unknown)

tools.name: check_email_auth
tools.description: Run the complete deliverability authentication check for a domain: SPF, DMARC, DKIM (probes common selectors), and MX records. Returns a scored verdict per area plus an overall summary.

tools.name: analyze_bounce
tools.description: Explain an email bounce in plain English: paste the full bounce message or just the error (e.g. "550 5.7.1"). Returns whether it is a hard or soft bounce, what happened, the likely cause (list quality, reputation, policy, authentication, temporary), and the fix.

bounce_text.description: The full bounce message or the error text from the sending tool

code.description: Just the bounce code, e.g. 550 or 550 5.7.1 (alternative to bounce_text)

tools.name: check_blacklists
tools.description: Check a domain's sending IPs (resolved from its mail servers) and/or a specific IP against 7 major DNS blacklists (Spamhaus ZEN, SpamCop, PSBL, UCEPROTECT, Mailspike, DroneBL, UBL). Reports listed or clean per list, per IP.

domain.description: Domain whose mail-server IPs should be checked, e.g. example.com

ip.description: A specific IPv4 address to check, e.g. 192.0.2.10

tools.name: check_mx_health
tools.description: Look up a domain's MX records and evaluate them: priorities, whether each mail server resolves, the likely mail provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, …), and obvious misconfigurations. Returns a scored verdict with findings.

tools.name: analyze_email_headers
tools.description: Explain raw email headers in plain English: the Authentication-Results verdicts for SPF, DKIM and DMARC (with the domains each check covered), From vs Return-Path alignment, and the Received hop count. Paste the full headers ("Show original" in Gmail).

headers.description: The raw email headers, pasted in full

tools.name: get_domain_health
tools.description: One combined health report for a domain: SPF, DKIM (common selectors), DMARC, MX and blacklist status, with an overall score out of 100, the top problems, and the recommended fix order.

tools.name: analyze_dmarc_report
tools.description: Explain a DMARC aggregate report in plain English: paste the report XML (the files sent to your rua address; several reports pasted together also work). Returns the reporting organisation and domain, total and passing message counts, a per-source breakdown (source IP, messages, SPF/DKIM verdicts, disposition) labelled as a legitimate sender, a forwarding / mailing-list pattern, or failing-and-suspicious — plus the top problems in fix order.

report_xml.description: The DMARC aggregate report XML in full (unzipped). Several reports pasted back to back are combined.
